dark-panel.$comment: Dark panel — a deep, rounded call-to-action block that stays dark in light AND dark mode (surface.deep). Everything inside it inherits the light-on-deep pair, including Buttons: the secondary and ghost variants read the page's ink and would vanish on a deep ground, so the panel repoints them, and the focus ring, to the on-deep foreground. Primary already carries its own fill and needs nothing. Danger keeps its red outline but takes a light label, since the status red is below AA as text on a deep ground.

focus-ring-color.comment: the page ring is ink in light mode, which disappears on this ground

secondary-fill.comment: an inverted secondary: light fill on the deep ground

danger-text.comment: the danger label at rest — the status red is below AA as text on this ground, so the label goes light and the outline carries the red
